data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jabara' which means 'to overcome, to subdue, or to be mighty'. In Islamic tradition, Jabrayah is a name given to those who possess strength, courage, and resilience, often used for girls. The name Jabrayah carries the meaning “The Subduer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabrayah usually hope their child will grow to embody the subduer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
